clozeMedium.translation: 她纖細的腰身讓這件長禮服看起來很優雅。
clozeMedium.clue: 能讓長禮服顯優雅的是纖細腰身

clozeMedium.sentence: The ballet teacher has a ___ body from years of practice.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The ballet teacher has a slender body from years of practice.
clozeMedium.translation: 那位芭蕾老師因多年練習而有纖細的身材。
clozeMedium.clue: 多年舞蹈練習練出纖細體態

clozeHard.sentence: The princess in the painting has a ___ waist that looks almost too thin to be real.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The princess in the painting has a slender waist that looks almost too thin to be real.
clozeHard.translation: 畫中的公主有著纖細的腰，瘦得幾乎不像真的。
clozeHard.clue: 畫中優雅的細腰是纖細的

entries.example: My aunt stays slim by walking every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我阿姨每天早上散步來保持苗條。

cloze.sentence: She hopes to get ___ before summer by jogging every day.
cloze.fullSentence: She hopes to get slim before summer by jogging every day.
cloze.translation: 她希望藉著每天慢跑在夏天來臨前變苗條。
cloze.clue: 每天慢跑是為了變苗條

clozeEasy.sentence: Eating more vegetables and less junk food keeps you healthy and ___.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Eating more vegetables and less junk food keeps you healthy and slim.
clozeEasy.translation: 多吃蔬菜、少吃垃圾食物能讓你健康又苗條。
clozeEasy.clue: 健康飲食讓身材苗條

clozeEasy.sentence: My grandma is seventy but still ___ because she walks every morning.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: My grandma is seventy but still slim because she walks every morning.
clozeEasy.translation: 我奶奶七十歲了依然苗條，因為她每天早上散步。
clozeEasy.clue: 天天散步維持苗條

clozeMedium.sentence: After three months of swimming, Tom's waist became ___.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: After three months of swimming, Tom's waist became slim.
clozeMedium.translation: 游了三個月的泳之後，湯姆的腰變細了。
clozeMedium.clue: 長期游泳讓腰圍變細

clozeMedium.sentence: The bride looked ___ and beautiful in her simple white dress after months of yoga.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The bride looked slim and beautiful in her simple white dress after months of yoga.
clozeMedium.translation: 做了幾個月瑜珈之後，新娘穿著簡約白紗看起來苗條又美麗。
clozeMedium.clue: 練瑜珈後穿婚紗顯得苗條

clozeHard.sentence: Though he eats a lot, he stays ___ because he swims every day.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Though he eats a lot, he stays slim because he swims every day.
clozeHard.translation: 雖然他吃很多，但因為天天游泳，他依然保持苗條。
clozeHard.clue: 吃多卻不胖是因為運動保持苗條

entries.example: My father is tall enough to touch the top of the door.
entries.exampleZh: 我爸爸高得能碰到門的上緣。

cloze.sentence: The basketball player is almost two meters ___.
cloze.fullSentence: The basketball player is almost two meters tall.
cloze.translation: 那位籃球選身高接近兩公尺。

clozeEasy.sentence: Giraffes are very ___ animals with long necks.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Giraffes are very tall animals with long necks.
clozeEasy.translation: 長頸鹿是有著長脖子的高大動物。
clozeEasy.clue: 長脖子讓長頸鹿很高

clozeEasy.sentence: The ___ boy in the back row can see over everyone's heads.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The tall boy in the back row can see over everyone's heads.
clozeEasy.translation: 後排那個高個子男孩能越過大家的頭看過去。
clozeEasy.clue: 能越過眾人的頭看是因為個子高

clozeMedium.sentence: You must be over 120 centimeters ___ to ride the roller coaster.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: You must be over 120 centimeters tall to ride the roller coaster.
clozeMedium.translation: 你必須身高超過一二○公分才能搭雲霄飛車。
clozeMedium.clue: 一二○公分是身高限制

clozeMedium.sentence: The sunflower grew ___ enough to peek over the garden fence.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The sunflower grew tall enough to peek over the garden fence.
clozeMedium.translation: 那株向日葵長得夠高，能探出花園圍籬外。
clozeMedium.clue: 能越過圍籬是因為長得高

clozeHard.sentence: He can pick apples from the highest branch because he is so ___.
clozeHard.fullSentence: He can pick apples from the highest branch because he is so tall.
clozeHard.clue: 能採到最高處的蘋果是因為身高高
clozeHard.translation: 他能摘到最高枝上的蘋果，因為他個子很高。

entries.example: She wore a thin jacket in the warm weather.
entries.exampleZh: 天氣暖和，她穿了一件薄外套。

cloze.sentence: The ice on the lake is too ___ to walk on.
cloze.fullSentence: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on.
cloze.translation: 湖面上的冰太薄了，不能在上行走。
cloze.clue: 不能踩的冰是太薄的冰

clozeEasy.sentence: Grandpa has grown ___ since he started running marathons.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Grandpa has grown thin since he started running marathons.
clozeEasy.translation: 自從開始跑馬拉松，爺爺變瘦了。
clozeEasy.clue: 長跑讓人變瘦

clozeEasy.sentence: She cut the cake into ___ slices so everyone could have one.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: She cut the cake into thin slices so everyone could have one.
clozeEasy.translation: 她把蛋糕切成薄片，讓每個人都能分到一塊。
clozeEasy.clue: 要讓大家都有得吃就切薄片

clozeMedium.sentence: He is tall but very ___ because he hardly eats any meat.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: He is tall but very thin because he hardly eats any meat.
clozeMedium.translation: 他很高但很瘦，因為他幾乎不吃肉。
clozeMedium.clue: 吃得少所以瘦

clozeMedium.sentence: Wrap the gift in ___ paper so it is easy to fold.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Wrap the gift in thin paper so it is easy to fold.
clozeMedium.translation: 用薄紙包禮物，這樣容易摺。
clozeMedium.clue: 容易摺的是薄紙

clozeHard.sentence: Only the ___ kitten could squeeze through the fence gap; the others all got stuck.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Only the thin kitten could squeeze through the fence gap; the others all got stuck.
clozeHard.translation: 只有那隻瘦小貓能擠過圍籬縫隙；其他的都卡住了。
clozeHard.clue: 能擠過窄縫的必須是瘦的

entries.example: The ugly duckling grew into a beautiful swan.
entries.exampleZh: 那隻醜小鴨長成了美麗的天鵝。

cloze.sentence: The witch in the story has an ___ nose with a wart on it.
cloze.fullSentence: The witch in the story has an ugly nose with a wart on it.
cloze.translation: 故事裡的巫婆有一個長著疣的醜鼻子。
cloze.clue: 長疣的鼻子讓人覺得醜

clozeEasy.sentence: Nobody wanted the ___ broken chair, so we put it outside.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Nobody wanted the ugly broken chair, so we put it outside.
clozeEasy.translation: 沒有人要那把又醜又壞的椅子，所以我們把它放到外面。
clozeEasy.clue: 沒人想要的舊椅子是難看的

clozeEasy.sentence: The monster mask looked so ___ that the little girl started to cry.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The monster mask looked so ugly that the little girl started to cry.
clozeEasy.translation: 那個怪獸面具看起來好醜，小女孩都哭了。
clozeEasy.clue: 嚇哭小孩的面具是醜的

clozeMedium.sentence: Polluted water gives the river an ___ smell and color.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Polluted water gives the river an ugly smell and color.
clozeMedium.translation: 受污染的水讓這條河散發難聞的氣味、呈現難看的顏色。
clozeMedium.clue: 污染讓河的氣味與顏色變得難看

clozeMedium.sentence: Rude words can make a friendly conversation turn ___.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Rude words can make a friendly conversation turn ugly.
clozeMedium.translation: 粗魯的話會讓友好的對話變得難看（火爆）。
clozeMedium.clue: 對話失控變糟用 turn ugly

clozeHard.sentence: The troll's ___ grin frightened the travelers on the bridge.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The troll's ugly grin frightened the travelers on the bridge.
clozeHard.translation: 橋上妖怪醜陋的咧嘴笑嚇壞了旅人。
clozeHard.clue: 嚇人的咧嘴笑是醜陋的

entries.example: The under-weight puppy needed special milk to grow.
entries.exampleZh: 那隻體重過輕的小狗需要特殊奶粉才能長大。

cloze.sentence: The nurse said the baby is ___ for her age and needs more milk.
cloze.fullSentence: The nurse said the baby is under-weight for her age and needs more milk.
cloze.translation: 護理師說這個寶寶以她的年齡來說體重過輕，需要多喝奶。
cloze.clue: 要多喝奶是因為體重不足

clozeEasy.sentence: Being ___ can be just as unhealthy as being too heavy.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Being under-weight can be just as unhealthy as being too heavy.
clozeEasy.translation: 體重過輕和過重一樣不健康。
clozeEasy.clue: too heavy（過重）的相反是過輕

clozeEasy.sentence: The lifeguard weighed every camper and found that two were ___.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The lifeguard weighed every camper and found that two were under-weight.
clozeEasy.translation: 救生員幫每位營隊學員量體重，發現有兩人體重過輕。
clozeEasy.clue: 量體重後發現的是體重不足

clozeMedium.sentence: Because the puppy is ___, the vet gave it special high-calorie food.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Because the puppy is under-weight, the vet gave it special high-calorie food.
clozeMedium.translation: 因為小狗體重過輕，獸醫給牠特殊的高熱量食物。
clozeMedium.clue: 需要高熱量食物是因為體重不足

clozeMedium.sentence: The newborn was ___ and needed feedings every two hours.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The newborn was under-weight and needed feedings every two hours.
clozeMedium.translation: 那個新生兒體重不足，需要每兩小時餵一次奶。
clozeMedium.clue: 需要密集餵奶是因為體重不足

clozeHard.sentence: The coach put him in the lightest weight class because he is ___ compared with the other boxers.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The coach put him in the lightest weight class because he is under-weight compared with the other boxers.
clozeHard.translation: 教練把他分到最輕量級，因為和其他拳擊手相比他體重過輕。
clozeHard.clue: 被分到最輕量級表示體重不足

entries.example: The young teacher plays basketball with us after class.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年輕的老師下課後和我們一起打籃球。

cloze.sentence: My grandmother is seventy, but she feels ___ at heart.
cloze.fullSentence: My grandmother is seventy, but she feels young at heart.
cloze.translation: 我奶奶七十歲了，但她的心依然年輕。
cloze.clue: 七十歲但心境依然年輕

clozeEasy.sentence: Mom carries my ___ brother on her back because he is only two years old.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Mom carries my young brother on her back because he is only two years old.
clozeEasy.translation: 媽媽背著我年幼的弟弟，因為他才兩歲。
clozeEasy.clue: 才兩歲的弟弟是年幼的

clozeEasy.sentence: Puppies and kittens are very ___ and need gentle care.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Puppies and kittens are very young and need gentle care.
clozeEasy.translation: 小狗和小貓非常幼小，需要溫柔的照顧。
clozeEasy.clue: 需要細心照顧的小動物是幼小的

clozeMedium.sentence: The ___ lady over there is my grandmother, yet people often mistake her for my aunt.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The young lady over there is my grandmother, yet people often mistake her for my aunt.
clozeMedium.translation: 那邊那位年輕的女士是我奶奶，可是大家常把她誤認成我阿姨。
clozeMedium.clue: 被誤認成阿姨表示看起來年輕

clozeMedium.sentence: The ___ leaves of spring are light green and soft.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The young leaves of spring are light green and soft.
clozeMedium.translation: 春天剛長出的嫩葉是淺綠色而且柔軟的。
clozeMedium.clue: 剛長出的葉子是嫩葉

clozeHard.sentence: In the old photo, Grandpa looks ___ because his hair was still black then.
clozeHard.fullSentence: In the old photo, Grandpa looks young because his hair was still black then.
clozeHard.translation: 在舊照片裡，爺爺看起來很年輕，因為那時他的頭髮還是黑的。
clozeHard.clue: 頭髮還黑的時候人顯得年輕

entries.zh: 有青春活力的；顯得年輕的
entries.example: My grandfather has a youthful spirit and learns new things every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我爺爺有著年輕的精神，每天學新事物。

cloze.sentence: Regular exercise and a good mood keep her face ___.
cloze.fullSentence: Regular exercise and a good mood keep her face youthful.
cloze.translation: 規律運動和好心情讓她的臉保持年輕有活力。
cloze.clue: 運動和好心情讓臉顯得年輕有活力

clozeEasy.sentence: Grandpa's ___ energy surprises everyone at the park.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Grandpa's youthful energy surprises everyone at the park.
clozeEasy.translation: 爺爺充滿青春活力的模樣讓公園裡的每個人都驚訝。
clozeEasy.clue: 高齡卻活力充沛是青春活力

clozeEasy.sentence: She has a ___ way of dressing, full of bright colors and fun patterns.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: She has a youthful way of dressing, full of bright colors and fun patterns.
clozeEasy.translation: 她的穿搭很有青春氣息，充滿明亮色彩和有趣圖案。
clozeEasy.clue: 明亮有趣的穿搭顯得年輕有活力

clozeMedium.sentence: The actor's ___ looks make him popular with teenage fans.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The actor's youthful looks make him popular with teenage fans.
clozeMedium.translation: 那位演員顯得年輕的外表讓他深受青少年粉絲歡迎。
clozeMedium.clue: 受青少年歡迎的是顯得年輕的長相

clozeMedium.sentence: Her ___ smile made the tired travelers feel welcome.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Her youthful smile made the tired travelers feel welcome.
clozeMedium.translation: 她充滿青春活力的笑容讓疲憊的旅人感到溫暖。
clozeMedium.clue: 充滿活力的笑容是青春的

clozeHard.sentence: Even at eighty, Grandma keeps a ___ curiosity about new technology.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Even at eighty, Grandma keeps a youthful curiosity about new technology.
clozeHard.translation: 即使八十歲了，奶奶對新科技仍保持年輕般的好奇心。
clozeHard.clue: 高齡仍有的好奇心像年輕人一樣
